measured_state.background_services_breakdown: 9 stopped via stop_markers (pisa-service, canalysis-service, bixby-prov, ondevice-voice, voice-app, voice-client, context-aware-agent, context-aware-service, ghdaemon) + 4 masked for the current boot only (ipa, contents-recognition-service, sp-kpi, data-service). 42 more apps have app_disable=true in the registry but weren't necessarily running continuously before, so aren't counted as a process-count delta.
measured_state.to_get_a_real_before_after_number: Would require restoring everything, rebooting, measuring, then reapplying and rebooting again -- not done, since it costs two reboots of the owner's TV and wasn't asked for beyond this snapshot.

launcher.status: SET AS HOME/STARTUP (owner-confirmed, visibly verified first). Probe.dll set-home + vconftool db/appfw/home_appid and db/appfw/startup_appid all point to com.samsung.tv.AccountNudgeService now. Original value for all three was com.samsung.tv.csfs, saved in operation-and-sources-before.txt / preferences-before.txt under the home-01 backup; restore-launcher.sh (this profile's adapted version, taking app_id as an explicit argument) reverts it.
launcher.why_this_host: The first search (app_type='dotnet' only) found no usable candidate -- this TV's only 3 such apps are AirPlay components with zero dotnet/NUI references despite the tag. A broader search for app_type LIKE '%dotnet%' found ~130 real dotnet-inhouse apps. com.samsung.tv.AccountNudgeService ('Samsung Account UI Application', a promotional account-signin nudge) was chosen over com.samsung.tv.voiceassistant-music because its manifest declares no OS-level app-control auto-launch trigger. com.samsung.tv.csfs (the real Home/FirstScreen shell, 537KB AOT, 28+ privileges including bluetooth/settings admin and a watchdog) was deliberately left untouched -- too deeply integrated to safely repurpose, unlike the dormant AccountNudgeService.
build_adaptations_needed: tools/build.py and launcher/src/Home.csproj now take --launcher-assembly-name / MSBuild LauncherAssemblyName (default BixbyPromotion for the documented U8000F flow) instead of a fixed AssemblyName.
recipes/install-launcher.sh and recipes/restore-launcher.sh now take the host app_id and dll filename as explicit arguments instead of hardcoding com.samsung.tv.bixby-promotion/BixbyPromotion.dll.

The host's original runtimeconfig.json declared netcoreapp2.0, not net6.0 (unlike bixby-promotion on U8000F, which apparently already matched net6.0) -- install-launcher.sh now also deploys and backs up a matching runtimeconfig.json, not just the .dll.

Home.cs's Root path was hardcoded to the bixby-promotion path; fixed to resolve from Tizen.Applications.Application.Current.DirectoryInfo.Resource at OnCreate so the same build works under any host app_id.

launcher/src/QuickLaunch.cs (the separate settings-bridge app, docs/04-launcher.md) still hardcodes com.samsung.tv.bixby-promotion as its app_control target. Not yet fixed -- the settings bridge has not been attempted on this TV.

Confirmed by manual switching through the native Home while reading Probe's current_source.
